root_cause: Live content supervisor v34 timed out its Anthropic-backed content orchestrator after 40 seconds. An in-flight downstream content generation later wrote a valid blog artifact but the supervisor recorded INITIAL_DECISION_MATERIALIZATION_FAILED, held the lease and did not process the remaining content. It can repeat hourly.
change: Increase orchestrator child timeout to 75 seconds, perform at most one generative call per canonical tick and do not immediately call a second generation after bootstrap. Preserve hourly scheduler and provider side-effect fences. Avoid exceeding 120 second existing supervisory HTTP budget through sequential 4x75 second calls.

prevention: On every canonical hourly run, bound generative processing to one AI call with enough time for Anthropic inference.
Do not treat a client-side timeout as proof that a generation has failed or did not persist; reconcile subsequent readback.
Preserve one supervisor lease and never invoke the same child twice when a timed-out provider action could still be running.
Real LinkedIn/Meta IDs and public readback are mandatory before a post is counted as delivered.
